title: Restore your work files after a crash by texting an agent
summary: A business owner says his Hermes Agent, which kept backups on a rented server, restored all his business files to a reinstalled Mac mini after one text message.
agent_role: The agent kept ongoing backups, restored files on request, repaired a remote desktop connection and helped with fixes. The owner sent the requests from his phone.
outcome: The author reports the agent restored everything after a macOS beta bricked his Mac mini, with no lost weekend.
what_they_did: The poster runs Hermes Agent on a rented server, a Mac and Windows machines. The agents share notes through an Obsidian wiki and can be messaged from his phone. When a test version of macOS broke his Mac mini, he reinstalled it and sent the agent one message to restore his business files.
how_it_went: He says the agent restored everything from backups it had quietly kept. He also reports it repaired a broken remote desktop connection while he was away from the office.
worth_knowing: This only worked because the agent had been backing up files beforehand on a separate server. The agent can't restore what it never saved.
prompt: Every night, back up the folders [list of folders] from my computer to [backup location] and keep a short log of what changed. If I message you that my computer was reset, show me what you plan to restore and where, then wait for my approval before copying anything back.

curation.rationale: A personal account of a Hermes Agent setup that restored business files after a Mac failure and handled remote fixes by text. Real, but light on detail and heavy on promotion.
